data.name: Toricky
data.detailed_description:
Toricky is an old-school Action-Adventure game featuring unique mechanics based on fast-flying and physics.




Toricky and Momo are two exploring birds, who are always looking for new adventures.
They embark on a new quest to a legendary palace where mysterious jewels called "Crystar" are enshrined.
But the palace, which should be busy with people, seemed deserted.
What could have happened? Where could everybody have gone?

To find the answer to this mystery, you'll have to use Toricky's amazing flying abilities to make your way across many zones filled with dangerous traps, and ferocious enemies!

EXPLORATION:


Storming a giant fortress surrounded by psychedelic mushrooms, or diving into heavenly waters infested with wacky piranha, this quest is going to be a challenge. Fortunately, Toricky's aerial abilities will let you explore each corner of the Crystar Palace's immense zones!

BATTLES:


Even if you want to be a peaceful adventurer, the nasty pirates who have overrun this region don't share your same view.
As a bird you don't have any weapons, but with Toricky's super strength, the world will become your weapon!
Even a pebble could be a lethal weapon in the hands of Toricky!

REFLECTION:


Many puzzles will block Toricky's path. You'll have to use your wits and the environment around you to solve them.

BOSSES:


Various bosses will stand in your way. Fighting against a giant robot ten times taller than you? That's a piece of cake for our protagonist!
Watch the enemy's movements carefully, find his weaknesses, and strike!

WONDERFUL SOUNDS:


TORICKY's OST is composed by the legendary composer HIROKI KIKUTA who worked on many video game classics, and DALE NORTH, a talented composer for video games and digital media based in San Francisco. The soundtrack's fantasy taste and use of traditional Japanese instruments are perfectly illustrating Toricky's particular world.

MYSTERY:


Toricky does not only meet hostile creatures during his journey.
He may also find the beautiful princess whose mystical powers rule over the Crystar Palace. If you can find her, she will be a great help to you on your journey.

FEATURES:

  • An Old School designed platformer, illustrated with beautiful hand-drawn sprites.
  • Interactive environments with a unique gameplay mechanic based around flight and physics
  • Perfect Medal (No-Damage Challenge) and Time-Attack for completionists
  • Non-linear gameplay with HUGE Stages divided into various Areas
  • Gigantic screen-filling bosses, each requiring an unique strategy to defeat
  • Story dialogues fully voiced in Japanese
  • Featuring beautiful musical arrangements by Hiroki Kikuta & Dale North
  • 3 languages available (Japanese, English, French)
  • EASY MODE for players who want to focus on exploration and puzzles

*It is recommanded to play Toricky with a Keyboard or a XBox 360/One Controller.
Any other Controller may require a few key configuration using the F1 option menu.

reviews.review:
Developed and published by Atelier Melon-Kissa, Toricky is a charming indie action-adventure that embraces the spirit of classic platformers while introducing its own distinctive gameplay mechanics. Rather than following familiar conventions, the game centers on the adventures of two cheerful birds, Toricky and Momo, who travel to the legendary Crystar Palace in search of mythical treasures. Their expedition quickly turns into a much greater mystery when they discover that the once-grand kingdom has been abandoned and overrun by dangerous invaders. What follows is an exploration-driven journey filled with hidden passages, environmental puzzles, oversized bosses, and an intriguing fantasy world that rewards players willing to venture off the beaten path.

One of the game's defining features is its unconventional movement system. Instead of relying on a standard jump mechanic, Toricky propels himself through the environment using powerful bursts of flight that are governed by momentum and physics. At first this style of movement may feel unusual, but with practice it becomes one of the game's greatest strengths. Traversing large environments turns into an enjoyable challenge as players learn how to chain movements together, reach difficult locations, and uncover areas that initially seem inaccessible. The expansive maps encourage exploration instead of simply moving from one checkpoint to another, giving players the freedom to investigate every corner in search of collectibles, hidden routes, and optional objectives.

Combat also distinguishes itself by avoiding traditional weapons. Toricky uses raw strength to grab and throw objects found throughout the environment, turning rocks, crates, and other debris into effective tools against enemies. This simple but creative mechanic keeps encounters engaging, as players are encouraged to use their surroundings rather than relying on repetitive attacks. The game features a wide assortment of enemies and memorable boss battles that require careful observation and quick adaptation. Many encounters blend movement, timing, and environmental awareness, making victories feel satisfying without abandoning the lighthearted tone that defines the adventure.

The game's progression balances exploration with puzzle-solving, ensuring that players remain actively engaged beyond combat alone. Numerous environmental challenges require experimentation and clever navigation to unlock new areas or reveal hidden secrets. The interconnected design encourages revisiting earlier locations after learning new techniques, adding a rewarding sense of progression throughout the adventure. Completionists have additional reasons to keep playing through collectible hunting, hidden areas, and challenge medals that reward skilled play, while the optional Easy Mode makes the experience approachable for players who simply want to enjoy the story and world without excessive difficulty.

Visually, Toricky captures the colorful charm of classic 16-bit adventures while presenting detailed sprite work and imaginative environments filled with personality. Every area introduces fresh scenery, from lush natural landscapes to mysterious ruins and dangerous fortresses, helping the adventure maintain a strong sense of variety. Character designs are expressive and memorable, and the Japanese voice acting adds warmth to story sequences without distracting from the gameplay. Complementing the presentation is an excellent soundtrack composed by Hiroki Kikuta and Dale North, whose memorable melodies blend orchestral themes with traditional Japanese influences to create an atmosphere that enhances both exploration and dramatic moments.

Although Toricky offers plenty of originality, its unusual movement system can take time to master, and players expecting a straightforward platformer may initially struggle with its momentum-based controls. The open-ended level design occasionally leaves objectives feeling vague, requiring exploration and experimentation rather than constant guidance. However, these qualities are intentional aspects of the game's design philosophy, rewarding patience and curiosity with meaningful discoveries and a genuine sense of accomplishment.

Toricky succeeds by offering a refreshing alternative to more conventional action-platformers. Its creative traversal mechanics, imaginative world, satisfying exploration, inventive combat, and memorable presentation combine into an adventure that stands out despite its indie origins. While the learning curve may discourage some newcomers, players who embrace its unique mechanics will find an experience filled with charm, creativity, and rewarding exploration. It is an underrated title that deserves recognition for taking familiar ideas and presenting them through an original and engaging design.

Rating: 6/10
